hq.noGeo: Location is not available. Allow it in your browser settings.
hq.err.osrm: The routing service (OSRM) is not responding.
hq.err.overpass: The OpenStreetMap places service (Overpass) is not responding.
hq.err.r.network: Could not connect to the service.
hq.err.r.rate: Too many requests — wait a minute.
hq.err.r.noroute: No road found between these points — move a point closer to a road.
hq.routes.lead: Plan a ride, save it and share it with the brothers. Weather, fuel and stops along the whole route.
hq.routes.none: No saved routes yet. Calculate a route and press “Save”.
hq.routes.localHint: Without an account, routes are kept in this browser only.
hq.routes.deleteText: The route will be deleted permanently.
hq.plan.title: Plan a route
hq.plan.loopHint: Returns to the start after the last stop
hq.plan.tip: Tip: click the map to add a point; points on the map can be dragged. Coordinates can be typed as “56.95, 24.10”.
hq.plan.clickMap: Click the map to add a point
hq.plan.noMatch: Nothing found. Try another name or pick the point on the map.
hq.plan.geoFallback: Type coordinates or pick the point on the map.
hq.plan.notFound: Could not find “{q}”. Refine the name or pick the point on the map.
hq.plan.needEnd: Set a destination or turn on round trip.
hq.plan.needLoop: Add at least one stop for a round trip.
hq.res.rain: Chance of rain along the way
hq.res.kindsHint: Official — data from public authorities or the European Commission. API — fetched automatically from open services. Member report — reported by club members, not verified.
hq.res.noFuel: No fuel stations found near the route (within 1 km).
hq.res.fuelGap: Note: {km} km without a fuel station, starting at km {at}.
hq.res.noRest: No rest areas are mapped along this route in OpenStreetMap.
hq.res.noClub: No club stops near this route.
hq.a.range: Part of the ride is beyond the 7-day forecast — weather for that part is unknown.
hq.a.cross: Crosswind gusts up to {v} km/h around km {km}.
hq.a.cold: Cold: down to {v}°. Warm gloves and a base layer.
hq.gear.cold: Tip: thermal layer and winter gloves.
hq.gear.rain: Tip: rain jacket and waterproof boots.
hq.gear.ok: Good weather for your usual gear.
hq.traffic.title: Traffic data: not available from an open source
hq.traffic.text: Live congestion, roadworks and closed sections for the Baltic states are not available from a free open API, so they are not shown here and the route does not take them into account. Check the official sources before you ride:
hq.traffic.links: External links to national road authorities — the data is on their sites.
hq.traffic.reports: Member reports on the route (last 7 days)
hq.haz.noneOnRoute: No hazards reported by members near this route in the last 7 days.
hq.haz.where: Location: map centre ({c}). Move the map or use your own location.
hq.haz.thanks: Thank you! The warning stays visible for 7 days.
hq.srcv.route: OSRM (OpenStreetMap road network, car profile, no traffic)
hq.srcv.osmShort: Source: © OpenStreetMap (Overpass API), within 1 km of the route.
hq.srcv.traffic: not available from an open source
hq.layers.title: Map layers
hq.layers.foot: OpenStreetMap places are shown when the map is zoomed in. Your choice is kept in this browser.
hq.fuel.title: Fuel prices
hq.fuel.lead: National average prices including all taxes, €/l. Prices at individual stations differ.
hq.fuel.diffHint: Right column — difference from the weighted EU average, €/l.
hq.fuel.ecSrc: Source: European Commission, Weekly Oil Bulletin (prices with taxes), loaded {t}
hq.fuel.viaUpload: file loaded manually from the EC website
hq.fuel.stale: The data may be out of date: a newer bulletin has not been loaded yet. Showing the latest known data with its date.
hq.fuel.noSrc: Norway is not in the EC bulletin. Source: Statistics Norway (SSB), monthly average for {m}, NOK/l, not converted to euro. Loaded {t}
hq.fuel.none: Fuel prices have not been loaded yet
hq.fuel.noneText: Prices are loaded automatically once a day from the EC Weekly Oil Bulletin. Made-up prices are never shown.
hq.fuel.routeAvg: Average prices in the route's countries
hq.fuel.noCountries: The countries on the route could not be determined, so no prices are shown. See the “Fuel” tab.
hq.fuel.aboutOfficial: European Commission weekly bulletin (average prices reported by member states, CC BY 4.0) and Statistics Norway (SSB).
hq.fuel.aboutApi: Fuel stations on the map come from OpenStreetMap; no prices are shown for stations.
hq.fuel.aboutUser: Prices entered by members are not collected at the moment.
hq.fuel.aboutStations: There is no official open source for prices at individual stations in Latvia and Estonia. The Lithuanian Energy Agency publishes station prices, but without a clear reuse licence, so they are not shown.
hq.pack.title: Pack
hq.pack.lead: Riding together? Enter one room code — everyone sees each other on the map in real time. Locations are not stored.
hq.pack.loginTitle: The pack is for club members
hq.pack.loginText: Log in with an active club account. Your name on the map comes from your account.
hq.pack.as: You will appear on the map as: {n}
hq.pack.liveMode: Connected — your location is shared with the pack.
hq.pack.gaveUp: Could not reconnect. Leave and join again.
hq.pack.denied: Could not join. The pack is only for active club accounts — check that you are logged in.
hq.sos.callHint: 112 works across the EU, even without a SIM card or internet.
hq.sos.msg: SOS — I need help. I am here: {link}
hq.sos.clubOnly: An SOS to the club is available to active club members. Help requests appear in Comms.
hq.sos.clubText: A message with your location will appear in Comms for all active members. If anyone is injured — call 112 first.
hq.sos.confirmText: All active club members will see your location and your request for help.
hq.sos.sentText: The brothers see it in Comms. Stay somewhere safe and turn on your hazard lights.
hq.sos.t1: If anyone is injured — call 112 first.
hq.sos.t2: Move the bike somewhere safe, turn on the hazard lights, put on a reflective vest.
hq.sos.t3: Do not remove an injured rider's helmet unless you are trained.
hq.save.title: Save route
hq.save.name: Name
hq.save.local: Without an account the route is saved in this browser only.
hq.save.doneClub: Route saved and shared with club members
hq.adm.title: Ride HQ stops
hq.adm.text: Club-approved stops on the map (the “Club stops” layer and the route result). Only published stops are public.
hq.adm.name: Name
hq.adm.pick: Click the map or drag the marker to set the coordinates.
hq.adm.mapErr: The map could not be loaded — enter the coordinates manually.
hq.adm.empty: No stops yet. Add the first one — for example the club's coffee stop or a meeting point.
hq.adm.deleteText: The stop will be deleted. The record stays in the audit log.
hq.adm.fuelText: Loaded automatically once a day (cron) from the EC Weekly Oil Bulletin and SSB. If the EC link changes, you can upload the original XLSX file from the EC website.
